What to Expect Paragliding in Ölüdeniz

First time flying? This is your complete practical guide — what to wear, what to bring, how takeoff works, and everything in between.

What to Wear

  • ✅ Closed-toe shoes — sneakers or hiking boots. No flip-flops or sandals.
  • ✅ Long pants — jeans or leggings. Shorts are OK but your legs may get cold at altitude.
  • ✅ Light jacket — even in summer, 1,960m altitude is 10-15°C cooler than the beach.
  • ✅ Sunglasses — essential. We provide goggles if you don't have them.
  • ❌ Don't wear — loose scarves, dangling accessories, skirts, open-toe shoes.

What to Bring

  • 📱 Phone — for selfies and receiving your media files via Wi-Fi
  • 💊 Motion sickness pills — take 30 min before if you're prone (rarely needed)
  • 💰 Cash or card — for payment at our office (no deposit needed to book)
  • ❌ Leave at office: bags, valuables, heavy cameras (we provide GoPro)

Weight & Age Limits

Max weight: 100kg (men) / 85kg (women). Min age: 6 years (with parental consent). Max age: No limit — we've flown 80-year-olds! No experience needed. Your licensed pilot handles everything.

The Flight Timeline

  1. Hotel Pickup: 08:00 (morning) or 14:00 (afternoon)
  2. Drive to Babadağ: 40 min scenic mountain road
  3. Safety Briefing: 5-10 min at launch zone
  4. Takeoff: 3-5 running steps, then you're airborne
  5. Flight: 25-45 min depending on thermals
  6. Landing: Gentle touchdown on Belcekiz Beach
  7. Media Transfer: If booked, files sent to your phone in 5 min
  8. Return: Dropped back at your hotel

Weather Cancellations

If wind exceeds safe limits, your flight is cancelled. You get a full refund or free reschedule. We check Babadağ weather at 06:00 on your flight day. Check best time to fly for seasonal advice.
